title: Eager Buyer
description: A family relocating for work offers double what you paid for any rental you own. Sell, or keep the cash flow?

title: Tenant Moves Out
description: A tenant breaks their lease. Each rental you own earns $100 less per month until you find someone new.

title: Stock Split
description: Every stock you hold splits two for one. Twice the shares, same total value today.

title: Highway Comes Through
description: The state buys any land you own for the new highway at one and a half times what you paid. You cannot refuse.
